name: Seam Clipboard
description:
Reads and writes the clipboard for Seam (https://github.com/aveterosystems/seam), so what you copy reaches your own paired Android phone without clicking Send, and what you copy on the phone lands here.

Only the Seam app can use it. Seam only asks while you have turned on Clipboard sync, and sends copies only to your phone, end-to-end encrypted. Nothing you copy is kept or logged.
